title: The file exists. Why no download?
subtitle: ReelPilot / the gap between a rename and SQL commit

panels.title: It looks finished
panels.bubble: The file is here! Still HTTP 409?
panels.caption: A result file may exist before database completion commits.

panels.title: Killed in the gap
panels.caption: The fault test kills the process at this point: SQL rolls back; the file can remain.

panels.title: Serve committed work
panels.bubble: A file alone is not completion.
panels.caption: The test checks HTTP 409 for an uncommitted result instead of serving it.

panels.title: Keep verified renders
panels.caption: The frozen fault record ends complete with 1 render commit. No power-loss atomicity claim.
